# Custom Settings

Approved project-level tunable product limits and defaults belong here, for
example maximum lengths, page-size limits, retention periods, and numeric
thresholds.

What may be recorded here and how it relates to `SPECIFICATION.md`:
`CLAUDE.md` § Product Sources. Applying a change: `custom-settings` workflow.
